name: Jasjen
title: Father of one of David's mighty men
summary: Jasjen is a person mentioned in 2 Samuel as the father of Jonathan, one of King David's powerful warriors known as "the thirty." He is known only through his son, who distinguished himself in battle. Jasjen from Guni is listed among David's mighty men.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the list of David's mighty men
keyEvents.description: Jasjen is mentioned as the father of Jonathan in the list of David's mighty men, known as "the thirty" or "the thirty heroes."

keyEvents.title: The heroic deeds of his son
keyEvents.description: Jashen's son Jonathan was among the foremost warriors who faithfully served King David throughout his reign.

keyEvents.title: Parallel in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles there is a parallel list of David's mighty men where similar names are recorded, confirming the significance of these warriors.

keyEvents.title: David's mighty men gather
keyEvents.description: David's heroes, including Jashen's son, were a group of skilled warriors who supported David both during his time in flight from Saul and throughout his reign as king.
